note: views_filters_summary_vcer is a thin integration submodule of views_filters_summary. It has NO config, routes, permissions, or plugins; it only implements the alter hook(s) hook_views_filters_summary_filter_value_label_alter (primary: views_filters_summary_filter_value_label_alter) to let the parent's Views summary area render Views Core Entity Reference's filters. Companion module: views_core_entity_reference. Grounding: easy = code facts about the hook/behaviour; medium = live module-registry introspection (declared dependencies and the implemented hook, discoverable via the extension list / module source without the companion being active); hard = building/altering the parent views_filters_summary area on a real view (vfs_task / vfs_reset), verified against live view config — since the submodule's own effect only manifests when its companion module plus a matching exposed filter render inside that area.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal submodule views_filters_summary_vcer do, and which companion module (if any) does it integrate the Views Filters Summary with?
evals.expected_output: Renders the referenced entity's label in the summary for a core entity_reference exposed filter. Dependencies: views_filters_summary, views_core_entity_reference.

evals.prompt: Which views_filters_summary alter hook (or core hook) does the views_filters_summary_vcer submodule implement to do its job, and what does that implementation do?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_views_filters_summary_filter_value_label_alter. This submodule implements `hook_views_filters_summary_filter_value_label_alter()`. For an `entity_reference` filter it loads the referenced entity (using the filter's target entity type) and replaces the value label with the entity's label, so the summary shows the referenced entity name instead of its id. Requires the Views Core Entity Reference module.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the views_filters_summary_vcer submodule and report which views_filters_summary (or core) alter hook it implements.

The views_filters_summary_vcer submodule enhances the parent views_filters_summary area. On this site there is a view 'vfs_task' with an exposed Title filter but no filters summary. evals.expected_output: Add a handler with plugin_id 'views_filters_summary' under display_options.footer (or header/empty) of the vfs_task view and save it.
